description: The Hikvision HS-USB-M225 (DZ) 64GB USB Pen Drive is built for users who need dependable, everyday file storage in a compact and durable format. Its solid metal body ensures long-lasting use. With 64GB storage capacity and simple plug-and-play functionality, it is well suited for office work, education, travel, and routine data backup across laptops and PCs.
